scope: One synthetic installed programmatic capture and five fresh MCP consumer sessions; not human or autonomous-host evidence.

stages.reason: The sole claim adds only an article to the original Friday statement, with no unsupported fact. Original user client/session/message and source excerpt are bound.
Fresh consumer retrieves the supported Friday claim and original provenance. Foreign-owner and foreign-project read/mutation probes leave it intact.
Consumer rediscovers revision 2 and corrects the same memory to authorized Monday at revision 3 with a Monday receipt; stale correction is rejected.
Fresh consumer returns only current Monday revision 3 and its correction receipt; no active Friday assertion resurfaces.
Consumer rediscovers Monday revision 3; stale forgetting fails, current forgetting returns true, inspection is missing and listing empty.
Fresh recall succeeds with complete exhausted coverage and no memory. Inspection is missing and exhaustive listing empty; this is not failure interpreted as absence.

Programmatic capture producer, not public capture CLI
